notes.title: Patch v1.2: 'Reality tweaker' module
notes.content:
Hello Riders,

News in this Update:

[h2]'Reality tweaker' module[/h2]

The long-awaited [b]Reality Tweaker[/b] module is now available to all members of the Cosmo Riders guild! You can unlock it in the Research screen, and it will be automatically installed at the start of every Expedition. This powerful [b]artifact [/b]is a must-have for conquering the [i]most challenging galaxies[/i].

During an expedition, you can use the Reality Tweaker from the Map screen to [b]remove almost any stage condition or environmental effect[/b], giving you control over the battlefield.

[h2]Rework 'Supplies' system[/h2]
Supplies are no longer infinite—they are now limited by the capacity of the [b]Warehouse [/b]module. However, you can upgrade your warehouse in the Research screen to increase its [b]storage[/b].

Additionally, any surplus [i]Supplies will now be converted into RP[/i] when visiting the Map screen.

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decrease 'mods refund' cost to 5 from 10.
[*] Check and show 'not enough resources' message for Scouting operation.
[/list]

Happy rides!

notes.title: Dev Log: play test Bot and Visualization of play test statistics
notes.content:
Hello Riders,

With the release of the significant update v0.7, new challenges have emerged. These include:
[list]
[*] visualize game statistics across 4 galaxies
[*] tweak game configs and re-test everything [strike]multiple[/strike] more and more times
[/list]

[h2]Play Bot[/h2]

Introducing Play-Bot v1, emerging from nothing:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/f3fc3be7faae7b204703d7bc2e5882e81669497b.png[/img]

Main features:
[list]
[*] follow and auto-aim at the closest enemy and escape if enemies are too close
[*] prioritize bosses and extraction portal
[*] wander around and find enemies
[*] install new equipment and mods
[*] disassemble and enhance equipment
[*] select best rewarding stages on galaxy map to travel to
[*] and record statistics for each stage
[/list]

Also it has features for speed run (to verify checkpoints and global progression out of battles):
[list]
[*] skip all stages except boss stages
[*] complete battle stage soon after start
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/8f64eadd321b1ba57a9144dc23379b0208a8545a.png[/img]


[h2]Play data model[/h2]

Play Bot can generate Play Test statistics over and over again (not bored and not exhausted, anytime I open start stage the Bot jumps into it as first time, ready to explore the galaxy for new data).

List of runs' statistics Bot created not so long ago (where G0 means first galaxy and PR means Prestige number):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/a7c721d430747518a777ec3fcd9e14f8a06a96e1.png[/img]

Each run consists of: file with statistics, world savefile, research savefile. Per each galaxy stage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/e560542aa2d953a0b4c10b61d4a80a02dd707810.png[/img]

So I can load galaxy from any stage to play-test it by myself.

[h2]Play data Visualization[/h2]

Stage statistics looks like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/e151fd9aedcc91cd9efb7c214a2c6a48c206fc87.png[/img]

Then nodejs server is started in the root directory with savegames to expose files from local file system to local browser:
[url=https://gist.github.com/nanonull/0d7d63d3dde118a601157368b4d3b606]Github Gist[/url]

And finally Chart.js application renders plots from Json stats files of each run:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/54594372932d4d61d215062e9dfd79559d7b53a9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/904190dcfa329e3b01bdffff069e955730df5ee9.png[/img][/url]

It renders selection of run directories:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/1ea4385357492e094b69beb6c92059339dac1ece.png[/img]

It is also possible to render diffs btw two runs (select Run#2 and Diff is rendered):
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/720f3a9a73b84d306c7b4dfb016b73713e3dd650.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453280/b24f4903a7b0b309d7c190c6e4878ccc32609df7.png[/img][/url]

It helps to find anomalies btw multiple runs.

Conclusion:
[list]
[*] play bots can reduce repetitive tasks, and visualization of statistics can help to see the hourly timeline on one screen
[*] play bot doesn't replace manual play test, it's an addition with use of correlation
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4.11: New Boss and AI units
notes.content:
Hello Riders!

[h2]Season EA#2 has begun.[/h2]
Leaderboard is reset. Congratulations to Season EA#1 Top#3 performers:
[olist]
[*] [b]_link13 [/b]- 202,726 points
[*] [b]shadow3671 [/b]- 46,448 points

[/olist]
Thank you everyone who participated!

[h2]Introducing New Boss - Winger-Mortario[/h2]

This nimble adversary deploys numerous mines and directs them toward the player. With an upgraded Energy Shield, you can deflect these mines back towards the unit. Check out an example in the video below.

[previewyoutube=hhz_IsAbCRc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Four New Units Added[/h2]
We've introduced four new units, bringing the total to 22 common units:

[olist]
[*] Rochalien-Brawler-Explosive (Tier#2): This unit not only ignites on contact but also explodes after a delay.
[*] Rochalien-Brawler-Mortar (Tier#3): Charging towards you, it quickly spawns three bombs.
[*] Rochalien-Frigate-Shotgun (Tier#4): A swift unit that can attach to you, slowing you down before unleashing a devastating shotgun blast. Approach with caution!
[*] Bone-Eagle-N2 (Tier#5): This unit pulls you in with Graviton and then unleashes a barrage of rockets.
[/olist]

[h3]AI Enhancements[/h3]
We've toughened up the existing AI units while reducing the limit of AI units per team from 25 to 20. Expect improved AI targeting and behavior.

[h3]Enhanced Projectile Visibility[/h3]
Projectiles are now visible in dark stages and are color-coded by team. This change levels the playing field in bullet-hell scenarios.

[h3]Graviton Module Updates[/h3]
We've merged the Graviton-Ignore-Allies mod with the Graviton-Advanced mod and updated Graviton logic to reduce the pull force on heavy objects. While this may not simulate real gravity, it makes the Graviton module more predictable. Remember, it's still a portable gravity generator!

We hope you enjoy these updates!
